sn15.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn15.1:1.8: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjā nīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaññojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.
sn15.1:1.9: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso yaṃ imasmiṃ jambūdīpe tiṇa kaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ tacchetvā ekajjhaṃ saṃhareyya ekajjhaṃ saṃharitvā caturaṅgulaṃ caturaṅgulaṃ ghaṭikaṃ karitvā nikkhipeyya
sn15.1:1.10: ayaṃ me mātā tassā me mātu ayaṃ mātāti. apariyādinnā ca bhikkhave tassa purisassa mātu mātaro assu atha imasmiṃ jambūdīpe tiṇakaṭṭha sākhāpalāsaṃ parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya
sn15.1:1.13: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjā nīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaññojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ
sn15.1:1.14: evaṃ dīgharattaṃ kho bhikkhave dukkhaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ tippaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ byasanaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ kaṭasī vaḍḍhitā.
sn15.1:1.15: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave alameva sabba saṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ alaṃ vimuccitunti.
